mapper.select: SELECT i.symbol, i.name, w.priority, w.enabled FROM watchlist w JOIN instrument i ON i.id=w.instrument_id ORDER BY w.priority DESC, i.symbol
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watchlist(instrument_id, priority, enabled) VALUES(#{id}, #{priority}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE priority= VALUES(priority), enabled=1
mapper.delete: DELETE w FROM watchlist w JOIN instrument i ON i.id=w.instrument_id WHERE i.symbol=#{symbol}
mapper.select: SELECT i.symbol, i.name, p.quantity, p.cost_price, p.as_of_date FROM portfolio_position p JOIN instrument i ON i.id=p.instrument_id ORDER BY i.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portfolio_position(instrument_id, quantity, cost_price, as_of_date) VALUES(#{instrumentId}, #{quantity}, #{costPrice}, #{asOfDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity= VALUES(quantity), cost_price= VALUES(cost_price), as_of_date= VALUES(as_of_date)
mapper.select: SELECT total_assets,as_of_date FROM portfolio_account WHERE id=1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portfolio_account(id, total_assets, as_of_date) VALUES(1, #{assets}, #{date}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_assets= VALUES(total_assets), as_of_date= VALUES(as_of_date)
